children: Overview
U.S. beverage maker's fiscal Q1 sales were flat yr/yr, EPS declined
Company attributed sales weakness to consumer sentiment and tariffs, margins pressured by higher input costs
Company paid $304 mln special dividend during the quarter
Outlook
Company says market conditions remain soft but reports a rebound in orders during August
National Beverage expects recently instituted pricing actions to improve performance
Company continues to monitor volatile input costs and tariffs impacting margins
Result Drivers
VOLUME DECLINES - Co said higher average selling prices were largely offset by lower volumes due to weak consumer sentiment and tariffs
HIGHER INPUT COSTS - Gross margin was affected by higher packaging and ingredient costs, especially elevated aluminum costs and tariffs, as well as increased fuel and freight expenses
TARIFF COST ABSORPTION - Co said it absorbed a portion of tariff-related cost increases at the request of the current administration
